title: Either way, the count stays five
odia:
କର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମଲେ ପାଞ୍ଚ
ଅର୍ଜୁନ ମଲେ ପାଞ୍ଚ।
literal_meaning: If Karna dies, five; if Arjuna dies, five.
meaning_odia: ଯେଉଁ ପଟର ଘଟଣା ଘଟୁନା କାହିଁକି, ଶେଷରେ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ବା ସ୍ଥିତି ସମାନ ରହିବାର କଥା। କର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଓ ଅର୍ଜୁନଙ୍କ ନାମ ବଦଳିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦୁଇ ପଦର ଶେଷରେ ପାଞ୍ଚ ହିଁ ରହୁଛି।
explanation: Two different outcomes leave the same total. The inspected compilation explains the proverb as a situation in which number or position remains unchanged. Its repeated five places the emphasis on that unchanged result, even though the two named people differ.
usage_example: A team fills one vacant place by moving someone from another team, leaving the same total number of vacancies. Someone could use the saying to point out that the overall position has not improved. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The source connects the lines with Karna and Kunti in the Mahabharata: in its account, either Karna or Arjuna would survive and Kunti would still have five sons. That numerical contrast explains the refrain without requiring a retelling of the surrounding epic.

witnesses.locator: Inspected public page line213, corresponding Karna/Arjuna saying.
witnesses.note: Public opening is corrupted as କର୍ଡ଼ ମର୍ଲେ; final ପାଞ୍ଚ is complete. Not claimed as exact full-wording witness.
